title: Posted Schedule: The Surcharge on a Repeated Roll Under Grain Marketing Contracts
content:
A member who moves the same position out more than once pays more for each further move. The surcharge below is added to the base roll rate on Grain Marketing Contracts, and it rises with the rolls the contract has already taken.

| Roll confirmations already standing on the contract | Repeat surcharge added to the base roll rate |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 0.015 per bushel |
| Exactly one | 0.0075 per bushel |
| None | none |

The count is of roll confirmations already standing on the contract, not of the roll now being put through. A contract with one confirmation standing takes 0.0075 on its second roll; the same contract, once that second confirmation stands, takes 0.015 on its third and on any after it.

## Illustration on hypothetical figures

On a hypothetical 4,000 chargeable bushels at a base roll rate of 0.03, a first roll carries no surcharge and the rate stands at 0.03. A second roll, with one confirmation already standing, is worked at 0.0375, being the base rate plus 0.0075. A third, with two confirmations standing, is worked at 0.045, being the base rate plus 0.015.
